title: (PDF) ‘Curcumin’ A Therapeutic Approach: A review
abstract:
Phase I studies showed no toxicity in humans consuming up to 8 g of curcumin daily for three months. Higher doses, like 12 g, did not yield significant short-term adverse effects, indicating a feasible range for clinical trials.
Curcumin has a surprisingly wide range of beneficial properties, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, chemopreventive and chemotherapeutic activity. The pleiotropic activities of curcumin derive from its complex chemistry as well as its ability to influence multiple signaling pathways and exhibits great promise as a therapeutic agent which is currently in human clinical trials for a variety of conditions.
